scope: Single two-seed paired short continuation, not full6000-step retraining or architecture change. Prior adapter draft never installed or run.
sole_difference: Control original total loss; terminal arm adds true-terminal posterior symbol NLL with same per-boundary coefficient as an existing current-symbol term. No other original losses or their weights change.
equation: L_terminal=0.5*sum_i(symbol_nll(post[length_i],target[length_i]))/sum(step_valid); for four steps this is0.125*mean terminal NLL. length_i=sum(step_valid); exclude empty/padding.
architecture: Original WorldModel unchanged; all original trainable parameters continue, DINO stays frozen. No additional head,adapter,state reset,synthetic observation,or label as input.
initialization: Each arm loads identical joint_seed{0,1}/latest.pt at update6000, including AdamW optimizer moments; model equals original final6000.
pairing: First750 original index and latent-seed schedules,8episodes x2accumulation; same seeds, same draw order. Extra terminal symbols draw no RNG.
optimization: 750 continuation updates per arm; AdamW original moments,betas0.9/0.999,wd0.0001; keep converged lr0.00003 constant; original k3 loss and E/R separate clip1; BF16,matmulhigh,deterministic,4CPUthreads. Four fits,total3000 updates.
development_selection: Candidates250,500,750 selected separately per seed/arm by same mean dev(original k3 total + terminal term),fixed RNG81831,all30dev episodes,batch4. No current-only selection; tie earlier. Also report matched-final750 to expose selection effects. Models/selection sealed before historical20 inference.
evaluation: Original frozen model remains baseline. Selected and fixedfinal750 compared on dev10 and historically seen old_band10+gap10 A/B roots only; these20 are exploratory, not freshblind. No prior test10,C,D,new collection,uploads.
randomness: Original8-sample evaluator,RNG81831,batch4 preserves original native results. Additional suffix and component diagnostics run under forked paired RNG without altering main stream.
metrics: Current at h4 and h1..3 separately; task-held/InDrawer/drawer/all exact,NLL; corrections/regressions/rootbootstrap; actualterminal failures vs nonterminal failed-grab transfer; persistent true relations and extra positives; one-step,root purefree1..4,anchored purefree suffix1..3 without future E.
mechanism: Training now updates encoder,dynamics,posterior and shared readout. Do not claim current accuracy proves state correction. Compare forecast effects; at same histories evaluate trained internal states with original shared symbol head as posthoc single-component diagnostic,not further fit or selection.

budget.estimate_source: Original6000-update joint fits took1077/1149seconds,750 continuations with k3 and development checks expected~700seconds total.

data_gap: All8 real training failures at terminal placement; no executed failed lift, no nonterminal failure followed by new observation/action. Cannot establish grasp-failure generalization from terminal-mask repair. Do not add known exploration failures to training.
stop_rule: One group, no hyperparameter tuning or extension. Report negative result and minimal prospective train-only failed-grasp/recovery collection proposal if needed; do not collect.
